name: FOFA Quake Hunter MCP Server
description: An MCP server that enables AI models to query FOFA, 360 Quake, and Hunter cyberspace mapping platforms for asset discovery and security research. It supports natural language parameter configuration and provides comprehensive search tools for retrieving IP, port, and domain data.

FOFA_KEY.description: Your FOFA API key. Required for FOFA search tools. Obtain from https://fofa.info → Personal Center.

QUAKE_KEY.description: Your Quake API key. Required for Quake search tools. Obtain from https://quake.360.net → Personal Center → Key Management.

FOFA_EMAIL.description: Your FOFA account email. Required for FOFA search tools. Obtain from https://fofa.info → Personal Center.

HUNTER_KEY.description: Your Hunter API key. Required for Hunter search tools. Obtain from https://hunter.qianxin.com → Personal Center → API Management.
